attributes.action: Allow hospitality venues to remain open for the full England v Mexico match
attributes.additional_details: England’s match schedule was only confirmed after the group stage, leaving venues with little realistic time to apply for Temporary Event Notices. Applying for every possible England date in advance would have been costly and impractical, especially for small independent venues. A limited extension for this match would support hospitality, protect jobs, bring communities together and allow fans to safely watch and celebrate in licensed premises until the final whistle.
attributes.background: Allow licensed hospitality venues to remain open for the full England v Mexico match, including extra time and penalties. Support pubs, bars and restaurants after late fixture confirmation left many without time to apply for TENs, helping businesses, fans and the England team.

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
